properties.name: jwt.expiration
properties.description: expiration time for JWT tokens (e.g., '3600000' for 1 hour)

properties.name: jwt.secret
properties.description: secret key for signing JWT tokens

properties.name: cors.exposed-headers
properties.description: Headers that are exposed to the browser in CORS responses (e.g., 'Authorization,Content-Type')

properties.name: cors.allowed-headers
properties.description: Headers that are allowed in CORS requests (e.g., 'Authorization,Content-Type')

properties.name: cors.allowed-methods
properties.description: Methods that are allowed in CORS requests (e.g., 'GET,POST,PUT,DELETE')

properties.name: cors.allowed-origins
properties.description: Origins that are allowed in CORS requests (e.g., 'http://localhost:3000')

properties.name: jwt.refresh-expiration
properties.description: expiration time for JWT refresh tokens (e.g., '86400000' for 24 hours)

properties.name: oci.bucket-name
properties.description: bucket name for OCI Object Storage

properties.name: oci.private-key-path
properties.description: path to the private key for OCI authentication
